title: Shadow Scar
description: Unofficial Foundry VTT system prototype for Shadow Scar. Development state: visually polished character and NPC sheets with movable drag-and-drop Items, editable item description fields, symbolic attribute/skill ratings, Shadow Scar character-sheet inspired dark section headers and framed panels, improved dice-result readability, always-visible character detail fields including Rank/RP/Wealth/DI beside Inyo, item-based Quirks split into Advantages and Disadvantages, item-based Homeland Abilities, Clan/Rank Technique and Mikkyo sheets, stable rank-based Mikkyo Ki costs, compact actor-sheet creation controls for Techniques/Mikkyo/Gear/Weapons, item management, d6-pool rolls with difficulty/margin, active condition modifiers, resource quick controls, weapon rolls, gear use, armor-aware guided damage application, and starter content packs.
